name: Talkie Trivia
description: Identify a film as its clues come into focus. Make movie discovery a daily ritual, and keep a personal archive of the screenings you have played.
milestone: The web beta is available to play.

name: DeckLogic
description: Build, play and learn from your Magic: The Gathering Arena games. A desktop companion for Limited practice, descriptive match tracking and post-game review.
milestone: Development focuses on the Limited practice, play and review loop.

name: RIP FMV
description: Discover the games that made video playable. Explore releases, compare versions and follow the research behind a full-motion video channel in development.
milestone: Browse game guides, platform Titans and release comparisons with clearer mobile reading and a catalog that loads in manageable batches.

name: Time Travel Movies
description: Explore a researched archive of time-travel cinema, from genre landmarks to disputed cases. Browse film classifications, time-travel significance and supporting sources.
milestone: Explore dedicated film guides with Titan scores, release editions, research sources and mobile-friendly catalog browsing.
